_help:
Poetic Treasures. Only Nihira's own published poetry or her recitations. playlistId = the YouTube playlist of the series (the code after 'list=' in the playlist link); the daily YouTube sync copies its videos into youtube-latest.json and the page shows them automatically. items = entries you add yourself (they appear first and can carry a note). Fields per item: id (unique), title, lang ('mr' Marathi, 'hi' Hindi, 'en' English), author (who wrote the poem), date (optional YYYY-MM-DD), description (optional short note), text (ONLY Nihira's own poems; use 
 for a new line, a blank line 

 between stanzas), videoId (recitation video), source. Never paste song lyrics or other people's poems as text: link the recitation video instead.
subtitle: Poetic Treasures: A Journey Through My Favorite Verses
intro: Poetry is something very close to Nihira's heart. Watch out for the series "Poetic Treasures" on Youtube, where Nihira will recite a few of her favorite poems in her soulful voice.
emptyText: New recitations are on their way. Follow the series on YouTube.
